decision.argument: What evidence available by October 2026 addresses recognition of low-resolution single-staff melody and chord symbols into editable symbolic music, particularly Audiveris chord text extraction versus vision-model transcription, and their duration, hallucination, chord-timing and transposition limitations?
decision.why: Enlarged Audiveris still has 66.9% melody error and misses 30 of 38 pilot chords. Relevant sources can help select an intervention targeting these measured failures.
decision.hypothesis: Chord-text extraction may recover omitted harmony, while pixel-based vision transcription may address both melody and chord failures; neither benefit is established without evaluation.
decision.expected_observation: Sources describing applicable capabilities and limitations; evidence of unreliable durations or unsupported chord extraction would weaken the corresponding intervention.
